claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.build_time_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Giant Ancestry is one species trait whose core mechanic is choosing exactly one ancestry boon at character creation, and the options are mechanically heterogeneous rather than one shared family payload.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits-a supernatural boon from your ancestry

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.triggered_reaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Two ancestry options are reaction-shaped species abilities, but species traits currently admit only passive or activation mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Stone's Endurance... you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12... and reduce the damage by that total. Storm's Thunder... you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Three ancestry options are on-hit riders, but the current on-hit family exists only for masteries and is not available to species traits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Fire's Burn... When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it... Frost's Chill... When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it... Hill's Tumble... When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.take_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction trigger grammar does not cover generic damage-taken reactions or damage taken from a creature within a stated range.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take damage... When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OnHitTrigger.target_size_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hill's Tumble needs a target eligibility filter by creature size, which the current on-hit trigger surface cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it
